name: Rizuhble's Bombshell Geist
rows: Getting bursted in lane while you're low from your own bombs. Sell it when slots fill.
Your own bombs hurt you with spirit damage, so this cuts that too.
Get after Leech if needed. Ahead? Skip it until you're dying. Sell Healing Booster for it.
They dive you and you've got no way out.
Silences and hexes keep shutting down your abilities.
Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.
Their gun carry is melting you.
Most of their damage is gun.
Stuns keep cutting your drain and Soul Exchange.
Their burst kills you before you can swap. Don't buy it if they have Cursed Relic.
If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
changes: Round 13: new bomb build — style sources: lockbuilds official 'Spirit Geist' (Oct 18: Extra Regen, Mystic Burst, Extra Spirit, Mystic Regen, Mystic Expansion, Radiant, Compress Cooldown, Healing Booster, Spirit Lifesteal → Greater Expansion, Improved Spirit, Tankbuster, Leech, Superior Cooldown, Mystic Vulnerability → Mystic Reverb, Spirit Burn, Escalating Exposure, Transcendent Cooldown, Boundless, Echo Shard; optional Spirit Resilience, Healing Tempo) and deadlocklabs.gg's 'SPIRIT GEIST' path (Spirit Resilience 8/8, Leech 7/8, Greater Expansion 7/8, Escalating Exposure 7/8, Boundless 7/8). Every item is in one of those two spirit builds; no hero-wide pick rates used. Spirit Resilience lands the health spike: her bomb self damage is spirit (game text: 'Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated'). Mystic Burst: bomb 90 + 1.22x clears 80 at buy (103); Tankbuster: 140 + 1.22x ≈ 258 at 13.6k vs 165. Order: seemeta most popular 113213413342422 + ult (bomb maxed by point 8, matching deadlocklabs' highest-WR opening Bomb, Bomb, Malice).

Round 14: ability order is now seemeta's current most popular (Oct 5-19, 55.0% WR, 2,353 matches; its items are the bomb set: Mystic Burst 81%, Tankbuster 64%) 1131334242232414; the stored one didn't match any source. Counters sold Mystic Vulnerability, which is gone once it becomes Escalating Exposure: now Healing Booster. Divine Barrier added as the pricier Dispel Magic. Counter notes fixed (Dispel, Counterspell, Cheat Death: Curse is now Cursed Relic).

Round 15: ability order 1131334242232414 did not match seemeta: its most popular (Oct 5-19, 55.0% WR, 2,353 matches) is Bomb 1/2/5/8, Malice 3/6/9/10, Life Drain 4/12/14/15, ult 7/11/13 = 1132134133424224 (the round-13 order); restored. Counters desc was 121 characters (game limit 112): now 'Get after Leech … Sell Healing Booster for it.' (109); the official build says to get Leech first if you can't survive.
Round 19: checked against current public builds of this style; it is a real style, no changes.
Round 20: Late list: Witchmail and Indomitable added (official Spirit Geist MAXED late box) for a second and third health step on a hero who pays health for every bomb; total ~77k.
Round 25: order 1132134133424224 → 1132134133224424: Life Drain T1/T2 (the heal) before the ult tiers; Soul Exchange T2 silence before Life Drain T3.
